normalized.result: Yes, that's the right behavior. Since a saved search is holding onto the conditions rather than a fixed list, it makes sense that sometimes nothing matches right now — maybe I haven't saved anything fitting it yet, or I've since cleared those out. The important thing is it doesn't panic or quietly delete itself: it just tells me plainly that nothing matches at the moment, while keeping the saved search sitting in my sidebar and letting me open up and adjust its conditions if I got them too narrow. That way it's ready to fill in as soon as something qualifies, and I haven't lost the search I set up. Settled.
